ambience.label: Ambience
ambience.decorative: Decorative: sun position, not the weather
ambience.hint: It is decorative. The sky follows the sun's elevation over the circuit at each moment of the session, computed from its UTC time and the circuit's position (NOAA formulas): day with the sun above {day}°, twilight between {night}° and {day}° and night below. It is not the weather: no clouds or rain, which are not in the data.
ambience.hintFog: The fog only fades the far part of the track (at most {pct}); cars, flags, trails and the other layers keep their colour. At night the track gets a little lighter, as if floodlit.
ambience.hintSource: Circuit position: the centre of its outline in bacinger/f1-circuits (MIT licence), rounded to 0.01°.
ambience.hintNoLocation: We do not know where this circuit is (it is not among the bacinger/f1-circuits outlines): without its position the sun cannot be computed, so the scene keeps the usual neutral background.
ambience.hintNoTime: The session has no valid UTC time: without it the sun cannot be computed, so the scene keeps the usual neutral background.
